pad-ack-gap - PREDICTED, written 2026-11-12 before any console run (the sio-dma side session), PSX_VERSION = '0.377.332' (src), node hwtests/run.js pad-ack-gap
The question: is a pad's /ACK timed from the write (v0.377.331: flat over G), the byte's last edge (v0.377.330: it follows RX's sawtooth), or its own last /ACK (it falls by G)? It decides SIO.padAckDelay's reference and pico-tas/padcore.c's port.
The proposal: experiments/proposals/sio-dma-refit.md.
